scale.basis: dimensions on the drawing (270 height, 328/314 widths, Ø339.4 bolt circle, flange thickness 35, holes Ø30/Ø25). Plan sizes not dimensioned are scaled from views against those values.

frame: Origin on the vertical axis of the part at the underside of the base flange. Z up, X and Y along the flange edges.
body: Base flange: 314 x 314 square, 4X R60 corners, z 0..35
Lower round body: Ø328 cylinder, z 0..100; it closes with a taper/shoulder (approximating R50 + R13) up to z 131.8
Drafted square body: 314 square at z 35 tapering at 4.1 deg to 285 square at z 235
Top flange: 304 x 304 square, R30 corners, z 235..270

features.source: 4X Ø30 THRU (top flange), concentric with the R30 corners
4X Ø25 THRU on Ø339.4 bolt circle at 45 deg
relief under the top flange holes (section A-A)
relief above the base flange holes (section A-A)
open funnel cavity above z 170 (section A-A)
Ø100 central bore, open down to z 35

guessed: Base flange width 314: taken from the right view's 314 dimension
Top flange width 304: scaled from the front view
